text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: prod token service latency spike > 99th pct. Auto-page oncall.

sre_andrew: Acked. I'm pulling traces and QPS.

oncall_li: On it. Any customer-facing errors yet?

sre_andrew: Errors are still low, but streaming response queues are backing up and causing tail latency. Top hosts showing long KV cache stalls.

eng_infra_rohit: Looks like continuous batching is spiking on streams path. Non-stream endpoints look fine.

frontend_jess: Seeing failed streaming handoffs in the loadbalancer logs, clients reattempting and amplifying load.

oncall_li: Proposal: temporarily turn off streaming responses for new connections and fallback to polled responses (short-polling) to stabilize token throughput. Keep existing streams open to finish. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

cs_maya: Need to know customer impact. Which customers use streaming heavily? We'll prepare comms if we flip.

sre_andrew: Agreed. From metrics, ~7% of requests are streaming and concentrated to a few high-throughput API keys. We can apply targeted feature-flag + quota changes for those keys first.

eng_infra_rohit: Plan: 1) Feature flag: streaming_responses=false for prod-global default for new connections. 2) Rate-limit streaming path to 1 rps for affected API keys as soft step. 3) Swap router rule so /v1/stream -> /v1/poll for new sessions. 4) Re-enable incrementally once the queue drops.

oncall_li: Who will run the flag toggle and router change? Need deploy-bot check and runbook snippet.

deploy-bot: I can run the flag toggle via /deploy feature-toggle streaming_responses --set false --env prod. Will create a deploy log.

eng_infra_rohit: Command (ops console):
```
./opsctl feature-toggle set streaming_responses false --env=prod --scope=new_connections
./opsctl router add-rule --match path=/v1/stream --rewrite /v1/poll --scope=new_connections
```
Run these in that order, then monitor queue_length and tail_latency.

oncall_li: I'll execute. cs_maya, please draft a short note saying: "We're temporarily converting streaming sessions to polling to stabilize latency; minimal impact expected, can reconnect if needed." Add an ETA for updates.

cs_maya: On it. I'll DM legal for any customers with enterprise SLAs.

frontend_jess: Quick check: ensure client SDKs get a 302/302-equivalent or a header telling them to poll. We can add x-redwood-fallback: poll header.

eng_infra_rohit: We'll emit header via router rewrite. Also adding quota bump for poll endpoints to avoid thundering herd.

oncall_li: Executing feature toggle now. Will post progress.

incident-bot: ACTION: page created: #INC-2024-872, severity P2.

oncall_li: feature-toggle done. router rule applied. Emitting x-redwood-fallback header.

sre_andrew: Seeing immediate decrease in streaming queue length. Tail latency dropping. Metrics dashboard: token_latency_99 -> 420ms from 1.2s.

cs_maya: Customer impact list: 3 high-throughput API keys will see polling fallback. Draft sent to CSMs for notification.

frontend_jess: SDK owners notified in #devex. They will publish guidance to handle fallback header.

eng_infra_rohit: Rate limits adjusted for poll endpoints (+20% burst) to accommodate conversion.

oncall_li: Will leave the change for 30m, continue monitoring, then consider gradual re-enable by region. If metrics hold, we will re-open streaming for eu-west first.

sre_andrew: Agreed. Also prepare rollback: run ./opsctl feature-toggle set streaming_responses true. If error rate increases or queue grows >= previous baseline, rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: Deploy log: feature-toggle streaming_responses false (prod) by oncall_li @1735123498. Router rule added @1735123510.

oncall_li: 10m check: tail_latency_99 = 380ms, streaming_queue = 18% of previous. Continuing hold.

cs_maya: CSMs acknowledged. One enterprise customer asked for ETA; we provided 2-3 hours until full verification.

oncall_li: 30m mark: metrics stable. I'm starting staged re-enable for us-east-1 (region with lowest load). Rolling re-enable: set flag true for us-east, watch 5m, then continue.

sre_andrew: Monitoring. If any regressions, revert to global false.

oncall_li: us-east re-enable complete, no regression after 10m. Will proceed with eu-west in 15m.

cs_maya: Notifying customers that streams are being restored regionally; asked to report issues.

oncall_li: Full restore complete at 1735123620. Closing temporary mitigation. Postmortem ticket and timeline will be created.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation complete, monitoring for 1h. Ticket INC-2024-872 assigned to sre_andrew for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
